timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹455.63 Cr (+12.3% YoY), net profit ₹44.14 Cr (+26.0% YoY).
Campus Activewear reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹455.6 Cr, up 12.3% YoY, with EBITDA at ₹88.5 Cr.
Campus Activewear reported FY26 standalone revenue of ₹1,774.1 Cr (+11.4% YoY) and PAT of ₹150.1 Cr (+23.8% YoY), with Q4 revenue at ₹455.6 Cr (+12.3% YoY).
Campus Activewear Limited’s **Archana Maini (General Counsel & Company Secretary)** posted the earnings call recording for Q4FY26 & FY26 on 25 May 2026 at campusactivewear.com.
Campus Activewear reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹456 Cr, up 12.3% YoY, with EBITDA at ₹88.5 Cr.
Nikhil Aggarwal, Promoter, declares no encumbrance on shares held in Campus Activewear Limited during FY2026 ended March 31, 2026.
